title: Land Each Call in Its Category
prompt: Implement the three probe functions. The tests prove each call expression's value category with `decltype((expr))`.

tests.name: makeGreeting is a prvalue
tests.hint: A prvalue's decltype((e)) is the plain type T — no reference. Return a std::string by value.

tests.name: lvalueRef is an lvalue
tests.hint: Return std::string& bound to an object that outlives the call — a function-local static works.

tests.name: xvalueRef is an xvalue
tests.hint: Return std::string&& — a function returning T&& produces an xvalue. std::move(s) inside does it.
